fullPassage: As individuals, our ability to thrive depended on how well we navigated relationships in a group. If the group valued us, we could count on support, resources, and probably a mate. If it didn't, we might get none of these merits. It was a matter of survival, physically and genetically. Over millions of years, the pressure selected for people who are sensitive to and skilled at maximizing their standing. The result was the development of a tendency to unconsciously monitor how other people in our community perceive us. We process that information in the form of self-esteem and such related emotions as pride, shame, or insecurity. These emotions compel us to do more of what makes our community value us and less of what doesn't. And, crucially, they are meant to make that motivation feel like it is coming from within. If we realized, on a conscious level, that we were responding to social pressure, our performance might come off as grudging or cynical, making it less persuasive.

③ perceive: 주어 other people(복수)에 맞는 동사원형이라 적절해요.

④ proudly announce: 알린다는 내용이 아니에요.

questions.passage: As individuals, our ability to thrive depended on how well we navigated relationships in a group. If the group valued us, we could count on support, resources, and probably a mate. If it didn't, we might get none of these merits. It was a matter of survival, physically and genetically. Over millions of years, the pressure selected for people who are sensitive to and skilled at maximizing their standing. The result was the development of a tendency to unconsciously monitor how other people in our community perceive us. We process that information in the form of self-esteem and such related emotions as pride, shame, or insecurity. These emotions compel us to do more of what makes our community value us and less of what doesn't. And, crucially, they are meant to make that motivation feel like it is coming from within. If we realized, on a conscious level, that we were responding to social pressure, our performance might come off as grudging or cynical, making it less persuasive.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 혼자가 더 강하다: 소속의 신화 / ② 당신의 내면 레이더: 왜 우리는 남의 시선을 살피는가 / ③ 재판대에 선 기억: 목격자의 몰락 / ④ 유전자만이 우리의 감정을 결정한다
det.analysis:
① Alone Is Stronger: The Myth of Belonging (혼자가 더 강하다: 소속의 신화): 본문은 오히려 집단 속 관계가 생존에 중요하다고 해요. 반대예요.

② Your Inner Radar: Why We Watch How Others See Us (당신의 내면 레이더: 왜 우리는 남이 우리를 어떻게 보는지 살피는가) ←정답: 남의 시선을 무의식적으로 살피는 경향과 그 진화적 이유라는 글 전체 주제를 담았어요.

③ Memory on Trial: The Fall of the Eyewitness (재판대에 선 기억: 목격자의 몰락): 기억·증언 이야기는 본문에 없어요.

④ Genes Alone Decide What We Feel (유전자만이 우리의 감정을 결정한다): 유전자만으로 감정을 결정한다는 내용은 없어요.
det.tip: '남의 시선 살피기'를 비유한 '내면 레이더' 제목이 주제와 맞아요.

Your Inner Radar: Why We Watch How Others See Us
Memory on Trial: The Fall of the Eyewitness

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 come off as grudging or cynical이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 남들에게 마지못하고 진심 없어 보이다 / ② 훨씬 더 정직하고 자신 있어지다 / ③ 공동체에게서 모든 감정을 숨기다 / ④ 집단으로부터 훨씬 강한 지지를 얻다

② become far more honest and confident (훨씬 더 정직하고 자신 있어지다): 오히려 설득력이 떨어진다고 했으니 반대예요.

det.tip: 사역동사 make 뒤 목적어(that motivation) 다음에는 동사원형(feel)이 와요.
